limits: This observer performs only lstat and read-only Git metadata. No unlink, hardlink, payload hash, archive regeneration or reclamation action.
Root reported normal sparse checkout after K merge; causality is its report, not directly observed by this script.
Historical link8/link2 receipts remain unchanged. Absent physical root aliases are not counted as newly reclaimed here.
Current commit retains these named archive blobs; original producer archive remains. This script does not make a new remote publication assertion.
Any future physical rematerialization must get a fresh alias identity check; historical nlink fields do not describe current state.
